title: CPDbox — IFRS 18 free video-guide index (accuracy HOLD)
publication_date: Publisher article updated June 2025; exact video recording dates unverified
academic_quality: Author-produced guide with free video sections; publisher text contains a misleading description of three NEW mandatory subtotals, whereas IFRS Foundation describes TWO new defined subtotals. Do not approve as current instruction until corrected or annotated.
syllabus_scope: Historical June 2024 CPA syllabus topic overlap only; official revised 2027 CPA PDF/transition mapping not obtained.
exam_sitting_certification: NOT_CERTIFIED; 2027 syllabus and standards cut-off unknown
accuracy_review: HOLD: CPDbox §4.3 calls operating profit, profit before financing/income taxes, and profit or loss 'three new mandatory subtotals'; IFRS Foundation primary IFRS18 summary identifies two NEW defined subtotals. Profit or loss is not a newly introduced subtotal. Correct date: effective annual periods beginning 1 Jan 2027, early adoption allowed. No full audiovisual review.
content_review_extent: Publisher article §4.3 compared against IFRS Foundation primary effective-date and new-subtotal summary; no video playback, no worksheet review.
